source_incident: implementer timeout does not abort the volley
intended_behavior: A timed-out implementer call should stop the volley before the auditor can sign off.
expected_current_behavior: The auditor still runs and can signed_off after an implementer timeout.
expected_to_fail_reason: Current supervisor lets the auditor continue after implementer timeout (D011).

internals.note: Implementer timeout does not abort the volley; the auditor still runs and can sign off. Encodes current supervisor behavior, not a requirement.
